thesis: The episode argues that while quantitative models have become increasingly commoditized and easy to replicate, the true competitive moat now lies in the quality of data, including how it is sourced, cleaned, standardized, linked, and delivered. Consequently, durable alpha is shifting from the models themselves to the data foundations and infrastructure that determine whether opportunities can be effectively exploited.
